title: Farm-API
tagline: Flask REST API on Cloud Run for farm data & assets
intro: A scalable Flask API exposing farm data via Firestore and file assets via Cloud Storage.
summary: Stateless, containerized REST service bridging Jetson edge devices and cloud analytics—Firestore for metadata, GCS for assets, GitHub Actions to Cloud Run.
features: Dockerized CI/CD via GitHub Actions → Cloud Run

sections.title: Description
sections.body: A RESTful API built with Flask to manage farm-related data, integrating Firestore and Google Cloud Storage, designed for stateless deployment on Cloud Run.

sections.title: Objective / Aim
sections.body: Provide a secure data-access layer for internal systems and AI components within the company’s ecosystem.

sections.title: Role & Responsibilities
sections.body: Designed and implemented Flask endpoints, integrated Firestore/GCS, configured token/Basic auth, and set up CI/CD and Cloud Run deployments.

sections.title: Impact / Results
sections.body: Served as the backbone API connecting edge devices to cloud analytics, standardizing data access across teams.
